title: Raising Greater Awareness for Emergency Preparedness and for More to Be Skilled in CPR and First Aid
what_it_is: Raising Greater Awareness for Emergency Preparedness and for More to Be Skilled in CPR and First Aid

sections.label: Media platforms for emergency preparedness
sections.summary: The Ministry works with media platforms and Mediacorp to raise emergency preparedness awareness and encourage life-saving skills.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs whether the Ministry can work with media platforms to (i) raise greater awareness about emergency preparedness and (ii) encourage more members of the public to pick up skills, such as CPR and first-aid, in our community.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We use a variety of platforms, including broadcast, print and social media, to raise awareness about emergency preparedness and encourage members of the public to pick up life-saving skills.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Together with the Ministry of Communications and Information (MCI), we worked with Mediacorp to introduce EP and SGSecure messages into radio programmes, such as on Capital 95.8FM, and television (TV) programmes, such as Happy Can Already or "欢喜就好", Eat Already or "吃饱没" and Tanglin, to reach out to different segments of the population.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: More recently, MCI, the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) and the Ministry of Defence (MINDEF) worked with Mediacorp to produce a five-part series titled "It Will Never Happen Here".

sections.label: Publicising community first responders
sections.summary: Stories of community first responders are publicised and emergency preparedness is highlighted through social media videos.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Stories of community first responders stepping forward to render assistance during emergencies are regularly publicised.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We have also been actively highlighting the importance of EP through social media platforms, for example, videos on SGSecure advisories like "Run, Hide, Tell" and "Press, Tie, Tell".

sections.label: House visits and EP Days
sections.summary: About 300,000 households were engaged through house visits, and 55 EP Days have been held to date.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: As of December 2017, some 300,000 households have been successfully engaged through house visits where residents are briefed on the terror threat and SGSecure messages.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: The aim is to have at least one prepared citizen in every household.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: As for EP Days, a total of 55 such EP Days have been held to date, and we will continue to roll out EP Days to the rest of the neighbourhoods in Singapore.
